We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: In 2013 Oct, defendant Wang purchased forest land (林地) from Shi, got a logging permit for 10 cubic meters of mixed broadleaf forest. He hired Yang to cut the trees, but did not clarify the scope, resulting in over-logging: actual over-logging volume 40.202338 cubic meters (i.e., beyond permit). So illegal logging beyond permitted amount. This is "滥伐林木" (illegal logging beyond permit) or "盗伐林木"? Let's see definitions: In examples, "滥伐林木" used for cases where they cut without permit or exceed permit? Example earlier: "滥伐林木" used for cases where they cut without permit. Example: "北京西城区...未办理采伐许可证的情况下，指使他人砍伐并收购...". That's "滥伐林木". Another example: "非法占用农用地" etc. There's also "盗伐林木" used for unauthorized cutting of trees belonging to collective? Example: "林某乙擅自砍伐...集体所有的马尾松" => "盗伐林木". So "盗伐林木" is for cutting trees that belong to collective or state without permission (theft). "滥伐林木" is for cutting without permit or exceeding permit. In this case, they had a permit for 10 cubic meters but cut 50+ cubic meters (10 + 40.2). So they exceeded permit. That is "滥伐林木". Also possibly "非法占用农用地"? Not about land occupation. So charge: "滥伐林木". Also maybe "非法占用农用地"? No.

Thus answer: [罪名]滥伐林木<eoa>
